disclosure: IRD publishes no band closure or cents semantics for these tables. The cuts, closure, nil band and integer-cent arithmetic are Microcosm's declared convention (G8-r open rulings 2, section 1, 23 October 2026), not IRD's own semantics: t = max(0, x) in integer cents with no dollar rounding; t == 0 is the nil band, including qualifying loss records; each positive band is previous_upper < t <= upper; and the open tail is t > its lower cut. Four published label pairs share an endpoint ($20,000, $50,000, $80,000 and $300,000: national rows 29/30, 59/60, 89/90 and 229/230; age rows 27/28, 57/58 and 87/88); the ordered right-closed cuts assign each shared endpoint to the lower band. Ageing scales every finite cut exactly by the selected factor and keeps fractional cents. The income and universe columns name the d1952 stand-in measure rather than IRD's definition; no producer exists yet (G8-r2c) and no active row requests them. Boundary diagnostics report weighted mass within $1 of every cut and the fixed-weight change under the left-closed alternative; publisher reclassification is unavailable.
